#: HTTP transport input limits and request errors.
http.headerTimeout: The request headers were not received before the input deadline.
http.bodyTimeout: The request body was not received before the input deadline.
http.invalidRequest: The HTTP request is malformed or unsupported.
http.transferEncoding: Transfer-Encoding is unsupported; send a bounded Content-Length body.
http.contentLength: Content-Length must be one non-negative decimal integer header.
http.bodyTooLarge: The request body exceeds the configured size limit.
http.incompleteBody: The connection ended before the complete request body arrived.
http.invalidJson: The request body must contain valid JSON.
http.capacity: All HTTP handlers are occupied; retry after an earlier request completes.
